**Classic Lasagna Ingredients (serves 8–10)**  

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (≈ 450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (White Sauce)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (≈ 950 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (≈ 200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (≈ 50 g) |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, sautéed) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Carrot, grated | ½ cup |
| | Zucchini, grated | ½ cup |

### Quick Prep Tips
1. **Cook the pasta**: Boil lasagna sheets until al dente, then drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment to prevent sticking.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: Sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, then stir in tomatoes, paste, seasonings, and simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare the ricotta mix**: Combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Whip up the béchamel**: Melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk while whisking until thickened; season with nutmeg, salt, pepper.
5. **Layer**: Start with a thin sauce layer, then sheets, ricotta, béchamel, mozzarella, and repeat. Finish with mozzarella + Parmesan on top.
6. **Bake**: Cover with foil (to prevent burning) and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
